title: Union Shape
description:
Define a `Shape` type as a literal union `'circle' | 'square' | 'triangle'`.

Implement `getCorners(shape: Shape): number` that returns the number of corners for each shape.

**Example:**
```ts
getCorners('circle')    // 0
getCorners('square')    // 4
getCorners('triangle')  // 3
```
ai_context: Common mistake: using an if/else chain instead of a switch, missing exhaustiveness. TypeScript can verify all union branches are handled in a switch with a `never` default.
